title: Lightly Sweet Canadian Almonds Wrap
description: A nutty and sweet Canadian dish featuring almond essence, perfect for a date night, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, vegetarian friendly.
instructions: In a blender, combine almond paste, dates, maple syrup, water, and agave nectar, and blend until smooth.
Add the almond oil and salt to the blender and blend until well combined.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Prepare the collard green leaves by cutting out the stem and blanching them in the simmering water for 30 seconds.
Remove the leaves from the water and let them cool.
Place a large collard green leaf on a flat surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1/4 cup of the almond paste mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Place the rolls in a steamer basket, leaving some space between each roll.
Steam the rolls over simmering water for 10 minutes, or until the leaves are tender.
